name: Form Boiler Room
implementation_notes: Boiler Room Detail grid renders whatever rows exist (0..24) loaded from boilerRoomRecordRepo.getDraftWithDetails(), with Tambah baris/Hapus baris controls -- the exact same dynamic add-row/remove-row pattern as Engine Room Detail (screen-077's mobile precedent)

availableTimeSlotOptions() compares slots by their index in canonicalTimeSlots() rather than a raw hour number (since slots wrap starting at 07:00, not 0-23), mirroring FormEngineRoomView.vue's availableTimeSlotOptions() exactly

'Minimal 1 baris valid' (Time-Slot terpilih + minimal 1 kolom bacaan/status/teks terisi) validated at FE + repo level (boilerRoomRecordRepo.saveDraft() throws BoilerRoomDetailRequiredError) -- this station has 15 non-time_slot columns, all of which participate in the 'filled' check (no identifying/context columns to exclude)

The 2 enum status columns (Blowdown Executed, Sootblowing Executed: Y/N) are each rendered as a native <select> dropdown with a '-- Pilih --' empty option, styled with the existing .native-select CSS class; local SQLite has no CHECK constraint so no empty-string coercion is required in this repo (unlike the web backend, see screen-098/118)

The 3 free-text columns (Fuel Feed Rate, ID Fan Load, SA Fan Load) are rendered as plain text FormFields, not numeric inputs, because their paper-form units are mixed/ambiguous (Hz/%/tons, A/%) per the entity-catalog's actual field type
UNLIKE Form Threshing/Form Effluent Plant: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no CollapsibleSection, no static-constant data file, per this station's explicit scope

Every FormField id in the grid is set explicitly (e.g. steam-pressure-{index}) to avoid duplicate DOM ids across rows sharing the same label text -- FormField.vue's default id-from-label slug would otherwise collide, same defensive pattern as FormEngineRoomView.vue

Field order in the grid & template mirrors the migration column order exactly: Steam Pressure -> Steam Temp -> Feed Water Temp -> Feed Water Tank Level -> Boiler Water Level -> Water TDS -> Water pH -> Fuel Feed Rate -> ID Fan Load -> SA Fan Load -> Exhaust Gas Temp -> Dust Collector Differential Pressure -> Blowdown Executed -> Sootblowing Executed -> Findings = 15 total

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec was not authored for this screen in this task -- component test coverage (FormBoilerRoomView.spec.ts, 20 tests) is complete and passing, but there is no browser-level verification of this screen's full Simpan/Pause/Clear/Back flow in a live dev server.
